title: Key City Services: Budget & Library Focus
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened to hold a work session on **operating budgets** for several critical city departments.
*   Discussions specifically covered financial planning for the **Police, Fire, EMS (Emergency Medical Services), and Health Departments**.
*   Council members also received a dedicated presentation detailing **Library Services**.
